nvitk.restoration._cuda_kernels¶

CUDA raw kernels for GPU-accelerated bilateral filtering.

These kernels are ported from the legacy BioImaging/src/imaging/filters/kernels.py (see the nvitk.restoration.bilateral dispatcher for their public surface).

They are compiled lazily on first use so that importing this module does not require a CUDA-capable CuPy install. Importers that need a kernel should go through get_kernel(); importing cupy outside that path is avoided so CPU-only installs remain functional.
